3.  26-56205  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion regarding updates to

  the Billie Jean King Main Library.

  • Health department staff provided updates regarding the memo, as of last
  month the memo has been moved forward to the city managers office.
  • Subcommittee members discuss the upcoming Olympics and concerns
  regarding relocation of those experiencing homelessness.

  A motion was made by Member Noble, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Noble
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Scott

4.  26-56206  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion regarding updates to the
  Homeless Services Advisory Committee Recommendation for a proposal for a
  $50,000 budget plan for the Mayor’s Fund pilot hygiene project.

  • Health department staff provided updates regarding the memo, as of last
  month the memo has been moved forward to the city managers office.
  • The subcommittee requested that staff provide guidance on potential “hot
  spot” areas where a portable restroom could be stationed as part of the pilot
  program. The subcommittee identified the Multi-Service Center as a potential
  location. Staff advised that key considerations when determining the final
  location should include accessibility for individuals experiencing
  homelessness, as well as the location’s ability to effectively serve areas with
  a high concentration of unsheltered individuals.

  A motion was made by Member Noble, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3 Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Noble
  No:  0 None

  engagement and efforts to raise awareness of the Homeless Services Bureau and

  • The subcommittee members discussed potential collaboration opportunities
  with other committees within the City that have recommendations related
  to the work of HSAC. Subcommittee members plan to reach out to members
  of those committees to share ideas and explore opportunities for
  collaboration between meetings.

  A motion was made by Member Noble, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
